_allowlist_rationale._summary: All 28 remaining advisories are transitive dependencies of @angular/core@14, @angular-devkit/build-angular@14, or @angular/cli@14. They cannot be resolved without a major Angular workspace migration (14 → 15 → ... → 21). The workspace currently has no ESLint config and no webpack remote configs for Module Federation — those gaps should be closed before upgrading Angular. Remediation path: run `ng update @angular/core @angular/cli` iteratively per major version. Target: Angular 17 LTS as first stable step.
_allowlist_rationale.GHSA-58c5-g7wp-6w37: Angular XSRF token leakage via protocol-relative URLs (@angular/common). DevDependency in build pipeline only; app does not run in production from this workspace. Fix: Angular 21.
_allowlist_rationale.GHSA-jrmj-c5cx-3cw6: Angular XSS via unsanitized SVG script attributes (@angular/compiler, @angular/core). Fix: Angular 21.

_allowlist_rationale.GHSA-prjf-86w9-mfqv: Angular i18n XSS vulnerability (@angular/core). Fix: Angular 21.
